Indian regulator flags rabies vaccine batch as substandard

India's drug regulator has flagged a batch of the Abhayrab rabies vaccine as substandard and is investigating if it is spurious. The finding raises concerns about a vaccine widely used in India to prevent rabies, an infection that is nearly always fatal if untreated. The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) issued a notice regarding the batch. The investigation is ongoing.
